page.overview:
Who is Billwriter?

The billwriter is a man who is involved in the passing of bills. When the government decided to ignore Springfield when a comet was threatening to destroy it, he suggested they add on a bill advocating for $30 million of taxpayer money being spent on pornography. Everyone in the courtroom agrees with his suggestion.
